newsitem.title: USA: Host Marriott offers to buy partnership stake.
newsitem.headline: Host Marriott offers to buy partnership stake.

text.p: Host Marriott Corp said Wednesday said it offered to purchase 45 percent of the limited partnership units of Marriott Hotel Properties LP (MHP) for $80,000 per unit or $36,000,000.
MHP owns the 1,503-room Marriott Orlando World Center hotel in Orlando, Fla., and a 50.5 percent partnership interest in the 624-room Marriott Harbor Beach Resort in Fort Lauderdale, Fla.
Host Marriott, a lodging real estate company, said that the tender offer is subject to a number of conditions, including the tender of a minimum of 45 percent of units outstanding.
The tender offer will expire December 20, unless extended.
